name: gizza-ai/php-serialize
summary: Convert JSON into PHP serialize() format.

tool.description: Convert JSON data into PHP's serialize() wire format so it can be read by PHP's unserialize() — useful for writing PHP sessions, caches, or WordPress options from a non-PHP system. Mapping: null -> 'N;', true/false -> 'b:1;'/'b:0;', whole numbers -> 'i:N;', fractional numbers -> 'd:N;', strings -> 's:<byte-length>:"...";' (length is in bytes, not characters), and both JSON arrays and objects -> PHP arrays ('a:<count>:{...}'), keyed by index or by string key respectively. Object key order is preserved.

json.description: The JSON value to convert to a PHP serialize() string. Any JSON type works: null, booleans, numbers, strings, arrays, and objects (objects and arrays both become PHP arrays).
